study type: Prospective interventional cohort study (with an initial descriptive cross-sectional component)
exposure: Early levothyroxine treatment (LT) initiated before Gestational Week 9
outcome: Adjusted risk for an adverse event
Maternal TSH and FT4 levels at Gestational Week 24
cohort: 2043 (Study 1) and 2069 (Study 2) consecutive pregnant women attending their first gestational visit.
finding: Early levothyroxine treatment for pregnant women with suboptimal TSH (>=2.5 microIU/mL) and/or FT4 (<=7.5 pg/ml) levels at or before Gestational Week 9 is safe and improves gestation progression, supporting the adoption of these cut-off points for LT initiation.
followup_time: Throughout gestation, with specific hormone level measurements reported up to Gestational Week 24.
cross-section timing: Gestational Week 8 for establishing TSH/FT4 percentiles (Study 1); intervention initiated at or before Gestational Week 9 (Study 2).
gest_age: Participants were evaluated in the first trimester (specifically at GW8 for Study 1, and intervention initiation before GW9 for Study 2), with follow-up measurements up to GW24.
